seo.title: RD's Total Lawn | Lawn care in Levittown, Langhorne & Lower Bucks County
seo.description: Family-owned lawn care in Levittown, Langhorne and across Lower Bucks County since 2018. Mowing, lawn programs, aeration, mulch and leaf cleanup from a crew that answers the phone. Call (215) 688-1622.

promises.headline: The part most lawn companies get wrong.
promises.lede: Mowing is the easy bit. Hearing back, and knowing when the crew is coming, is where people get let down. Here’s what you can expect from us.

items.usual: A voicemail box that’s already full.
items.title: We answer the phone.
items.body: Call (215) 688-1622 during business hours and you'll reach someone on our team.

items.title: We call you back.
items.body: Messages and quote requests get a reply, so you're never left wondering whether we got it.

items.title: We tell you when we're coming.
items.body: Clear timelines before the work starts, and an update if anything changes.

services.headline: Lawn care for the whole season.
services.lede: Weekly visits, seasonal work and the cleanups in between. Tell us what your yard needs and we’ll put it on one schedule.

items.name: Mowing & trimming
items.body: Regular cuts with those clean stripes, string trimming, edging along walks and beds, and clippings blown off the hard surfaces.

items.name: Lawn programs
items.body: Seasonal fertilization and weed control. Choose the Base, Best or Bite-Free plan.

items.name: Aeration & overseeding
items.body: Core aeration and fresh seed in early fall, when new grass has the best chance to take.

items.name: Dethatching
items.body: We pull out the layer of dead grass that chokes the lawn, so water and feed reach the roots.

items.name: Mulch & stone beds
items.body: Fresh mulch, clean stone, crisp edges and weeded beds that make the whole yard look finished.

items.name: Leaf cleanup
items.body: Leaves cleared off the lawn and out of the beds before they smother the grass.

items.name: Mosquito control
items.body: Treatments through the warm months so you can use your backyard again.

story.headline: It started as a side business in 2018.
paragraphs: Ryan and Lindsay Dittes started RD's Total Lawn as a side business. Today it's a crew of about ten, looking after lawns across Lower Bucks County.

The goal hasn't changed since the first season. We want you to get the warmth of a small family business and the professionalism of a larger company: a phone that gets answered, messages that get returned, and a clear answer on when we'll be there.
story.faith: We're a faith-driven family, and we give God the credit for every bit of growth we've had. We try to run this business in a way that honors that.

items.q: How do I get a price?
items.a: Request a quote online or call (215) 688-1622. We'll ask a few questions about your property and come back to you with a clear price before any work starts.
We work across Lower Bucks County. If you don't see your town in the list, call and ask. We'll tell you straight.
Confirm licensing and insurance details with the owners and add the PA HIC number here.

careers.headline: Good work, good people, and a family name on the truck.
careers.intro: RD's Total Lawn grew from a side business into a crew of about ten because of the people on it. Ryan and Lindsay credit God and this team for every season since 2018, and they run the company to be a place people want to stay.
